thread:
miriam: Heads-up 1: Compliance sent a DSAR asking for a full event export + chain-of-custody. Amplitude retention is longer than our 90d, so RE likely required. Also see vendor CVE note.
devin: We should avoid giving Compliance a vendor portal download. Proposed: pull via vendor API into our controlled bucket, encrypt with CMK, produce notarized artifact, then grant timebound retrieval.
nash: Agreed. Requirements from Legal: requester proof, retention decision, and an auditable artifact showing who accessed the export. Security: least-priv, MFA, and JIT approvals.
sec-ops-bot: Policy: exports with PII must be SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key, object tagged with dsar_id, manifest sha512 included, artifact GPG-signed, retrieval via ephemeral role requiring MFA and two approvers.
devin: Implementation sketch: vendor-api -> service role 'svc:dsar-puller' -> writes s3://priv-dsar/6209876543/events.jsonl encrypted with arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/DSAR-6209876543. Then run PII-scan, create manifest.sha512, tar+gpg-sign (detached). Store signature and manifest in AuditStore record.
miriam: RBAC detail: ephemeral retrieval role 'dsar_retriever_session' should be created per-request via assume-role with sts:TagSession dsar=6209876543 and require mfa. Policy must limit GetObject to that specific prefix.
nash: KMS key policy draft (high level): allow Encrypt/GenerateDataKey to dsar-puller; allow Decrypt only to principals with session tag dsar=6209876543 and only when kms:EncryptionContext:dsar_id=6209876543. Deny Decrypt by default to everyone else.
legal-bot: Legal requirement: if vendor retention forces us to keep raw payload >90d, open RE and include a retention justification and expiration. Also require vendor attestation re: CVE.
sec-ops-bot: Checklist generated: [1] Open retention-exception (RE-1219), [2] CMK created + key policy PR, [3] Exporter job + PII-scan, [4] Manifest (sha512) + detached GPG signature, [5] AuditStore entry w/ evidence bundle, [6] Ephemeral role + JIT approval, [7] Presigned URL TTL <=1h, [8] Object lifecycle default 48h unless RE approved, [9] Vendor CVE attestation.
devin: Example CLI for manifest + sign:
```
sha512sum events.jsonl > events.sha512
tar czf 6209876543-package.tgz events.jsonl events.sha512
gpg --detach-sign --armor 6209876543-package.tgz
aws s3 cp 6209876543-package.tgz.gpg s3://priv-dsar/6209876543/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/DSAR-6209876543
```
miriam: AuditStore entry should include: dsar_id, requester_identity, legal_approval_ts, approvers, artifact_sha512, object_path, retrieval_history (populated after access). CloudTrail copies of PutObject/GetObject should be attached.
nash: Vendor triage: ask Amplitude for a signed statement: (a) CVE impact summary, (b) whether export endpoints were affected, (c) timeline of patch deploy. If they can't provide, escalate to CISO and pause export.
legal-bot: Opened RE: https://re.redwood/retention-exceptions/RE-1219 (cc security, compliance). Default hold 7d while vendor attests.
privacy-bot: Reminder: redact any vendor debug headers, strip tokens, and include a redaction log in the evidence bundle. Do not expose raw payload in Slack or CI logs. :lock:
devin: Small RBAC nuance: CloudTrail shows role ARN but not session tags in some cases; ensure we use sts:TagSession so AuditStore can map session -> dsar. Also add an ingestion lambda to copy relevant CT events into AuditStore.
miriam: Action items: Devin -> exporter job + PII-scan + CLI packaging; Ash -> KMS key policy PR & ephemeral role policy; Legal-bot -> track RE + vendor attestation; I'll verify audit artifacts before handing to Compliance.
sec-ops-bot: Two-approver rule enabled: security + legal both required to generate retrieval presigned URL.
devin: I'll post a prototype run command and minimal logs to this thread once ready (no plaintext). Expect a prototype within 6 hours.
miriam: Thanks. If vendor attests clean we proceed; if not, CISO decides. Keeping thread open for PR links and evidence artifacts. :memo:
